_comment: Single source of truth for every third-party artifact the project downloads or bundles.
scripts/get-singbox.ps1, scripts/vpn-windows.ps1 and scripts/vpn-singbox-windows.ps1 read this
file, so versions and checksums cannot drift between them. Never edit a checksum to make a
download pass: a changed artifact is either an upstream release or tampering, and both need a
human decision. Bump the version AND the checksum together in one commit.
Routing rule-sets. Their pin matters as much as the binary's: a rule-set decides which
destinations bypass the tunnel. The upstream 'latest' URL is used on purpose, but the
checksum is pinned, so an upstream change stops the fetch instead of silently retuning routes.

refilter-domains.srs.role: split mode: blocked domains routed through the exit

refilter-ip.srs.role: split mode: blocked IP summaries routed through the exit

_comment: Files that are supplied locally (not downloadable) but are bundled into the desktop app.
Their expected hash is checked when present so a swapped or stale file cannot be packaged
silently. Update the hash together with the file.

wintun.dll.role: TUN driver used by the Windows launchers

_comment: libbox.aar - the engine the Android app runs in-process - is built from this source, not
downloaded: upstream publishes no AAR. The tag AND the commit are pinned together, so a moved
tag stops the build instead of silently changing the engine. The Go build tags and linker flags
used are the ones cmd/internal/build_libbox/main.go uses at this commit.
scripts/android/build-aar.ps1 reads this entry, fetches the module version through the Go proxy
and refuses to build if the version no longer resolves to the commit below.
singBoxSource.role: reality/hysteria2 transports and the TUN engine inside the Android app
